trustPoints: Local owner-operator — not a national chain
Transparent pricing — daily, weekly, and monthly rates visible on every item
Automatic rate tiering — you always get the cheapest applicable rate
Delivery across Toronto, Markham, and Durham Region
Buy new or used — the same catalog is available for sale

faq.a: Every item has a daily, weekly, and monthly rate. We automatically charge whichever is cheapest for your rental length. For example, if 5 days at $85/day ($425) is more than our weekly rate ($340), you pay the weekly rate — so 5–7 days always costs $340. Same rule applies at the monthly tier.

faq.q: Can I rent multiple items in one order?
faq.a: Yes — add everything you need to your cart and check out in one go. One delivery, one deposit, one pickup.
Each item has a deposit shown on its page. Deposit is returned on pickup once equipment is confirmed in working condition.

faq.q: Which cities do you deliver to?
faq.a: Toronto, Markham, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Uxbridge, Clarington, Scugog, and Brock. Delivery price shows on every equipment page by city.

faq.q: Can I buy equipment instead of renting?
faq.a: Yes — most of our rental catalog is also available for sale, new or used. Switch to the Buy section on any equipment page.

faq.q: How do I pick up or arrange delivery?
faq.a: Once you place a rental, we'll confirm delivery time within a few hours during business hours. We handle drop-off and pickup within the service area.
